description: This file defines functions and types related to provider flow configurations, including setup flows, model picker flows, and their contributions, for an OpenClaw project. It manages provider documentation, flow options, and scope filtering.

methods.name: includesProviderFlowScope
methods.description: Checks if a given scope is included in a list of scopes or defaults to the default scope.

methods.name: resolveProviderDocsById
methods.description: Creates a map of provider IDs to their documentation paths, filtering providers with valid docs.

methods.name: resolveManifestProviderSetupFlowOptions
methods.description: Returns setup flow options derived from manifest provider setup flow contributions.

methods.name: resolveManifestProviderSetupFlowContributions
methods.description: Generates provider setup flow contributions from manifest auth choices, filtered by scope.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeFallbackProviderSetupFlowOptions
methods.description: Returns fallback setup flow options from runtime fallback contributions.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeFallbackProviderSetupFlowContributions
methods.description: Generates fallback provider setup flow contributions from wizard options, filtered by scope.

methods.name: resolveProviderSetupFlowOptions
methods.description: Combines primary and fallback contributions into a sorted list of setup flow options.

methods.name: resolveProviderSetupFlowContributions
methods.description: Merges and sorts primary and fallback provider setup contributions.

methods.name: resolveProviderModelPickerFlowEntries
methods.description: Returns provider model picker flow entries.

methods.name: resolveProviderModelPickerFlowContributions
methods.description: Generates sorted provider model picker flow contributions.
